findings: 2026-11-05: drafted for Mathematics 11 Unit 4 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.

Book correction: The book prints the range of the subscripts as a_{ij}\,(1, 2, 3, \ldots, m;\ j = 1, 2, 3, \ldots, n), leaving out "i =" before the first list. It should read a_{ij}\ (i = 1, 2, 3, \ldots, m;\ j = 1, 2, 3, \ldots, n): the first subscript i runs over the m rows and the second subscript j over the n columns.
